meta.title.string: Embed Fixer | Discord bot for fixing social media embeds

meta.description.string: Embed Fixer intercepts broken social links and reposts them through webhooks so embeds render correctly inside Discord. Supports all the popular platforms, trusted by 3700+ servers, and open source for self-hosting.

hero.tagline.string: Embed Fixer reposts broken social links so the full post shows, right in Discord.

problem.heading.string: Discord strips the point out of shared posts.

problem.cards.1.text.string: The image you shared is often missing.

problem.cards.3.text.string: Leave Discord just to see what you posted.

features.heading.string: Well thought out, and actually useful.

features.list.0.text.string: Broken links are reposted through a webhook with the sender’s name and avatar. Nobody has to do anything.

features.list.1.text.string: Use /fix in DMs or in servers where the bot isn’t installed.

features.list.2.text.string: Pull images and videos out of supported links into a gallery-style view.

features.list.3.text.string: {count} settings decide where, when and how links get fixed in your server.

platforms.heading.string: From mainstream to niche. If the embed is broken, we fix it.

customization.heading.string: Tune almost every behavior to fit your server.

customization.body.string: Nearly everything can be changed or switched off, including niche options that came from real community requests.

customization.noResults.string: No setting matches that. Try “role”, “channel” or “webhook”.

customization.settings.0.description.string: Change the language used by the bot.

customization.settings.1.description.string: Turn off fixes for specific websites.

customization.settings.2.description.string: Extract images and videos from X or Pixiv links in selected channels.

customization.settings.3.description.string: Channels here never receive embed fixes.

customization.settings.4.description.string: Only selected channels receive embed fixes. Overrides the blacklist.

customization.settings.5.description.string: Choose whether replying through the webhook pings the original author.

customization.settings.6.description.string: Skip automatic spoiler tags for extracted media in selected NSFW channels.

customization.settings.7.description.string: Add a reaction the original author can use to delete the webhook message.

customization.settings.8.description.string: Show the post’s text in selected channels when media extraction is on.

customization.settings.9.description.string: Choose which emoji is used for delete-by-reaction.

customization.settings.10.description.string: Choose which fix service is used for each website.

customization.settings.11.description.string: Choose whether links sent by other bots are fixed too.

customization.settings.12.description.string: Send fixed embeds and extracted media to one channel instead of the source.

customization.settings.13.description.string: Only members with selected roles get fixes. Leave empty to disable.

customization.settings.14.description.string: Show or hide a button that links to the original post.

customization.settings.15.description.string: Delete the original thread message after the fixed embed is sent.

customization.settings.16.description.string: Reply with the fixed embed instead of deleting and resending.

hosting.heading.string: Care about privacy? Run it yourself.

hosting.body.string: Embed Fixer is open source. Host it on your own machine for full control over your data and configuration.

closing.heading.string: If your server shares links, this belongs in it.
